<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Mani Home Making — Homemade Pickles &amp; Snacks, Dosapadu</title>
<meta name="description" content="Homemade veg and non-veg pickles, snacks and combo packs from Dosapadu, Krishna District. Order on WhatsApp. Courier across India.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500;600;700&family=Jost:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#FFFFFF;--bg2:#FAFAF8;--gold:#C6A15B;--gold-d:#A7833E;--champ:#E8D8B0;--text:#202020;--text2:#6B6B6B;--line:#EAE6DD;--ok:#2E7D4F;--err:#B3261E;--veg:#2E7D4F;--nonveg:#B3261E;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);color-scheme:light}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:84px;height:100%}
body{margin:0;height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:400 16px/1.6 'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{height:auto;min-height:100%}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;margin:0;letter-spacing:.005em}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-d);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:3px}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
svg.i{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 24px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:2px;background:transparent;color:var(--gold-d);font:500 .95rem 'Jost',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--champ)}
.btn.gold{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;border-color:var(--gold)}
.btn.gold:hover{background:var(--gold-d);border-color:var(--gold-d)}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.announce{background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text2);padding:8px 16px}
.announce b{color:var(--gold-d);font-weight:500}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:40;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:68px}
.logo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);line-height:1}
.logo small{display:block;font:400 .68rem 'Jost',sans-serif;color:var(--gold-d);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
nav{display:flex;gap:28px}
nav a{text-decoration:none;font-size:.93rem;color:var(--text2);padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
nav a:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--gold)}
.acts{display:flex;gap:6px}
.ib{position:relative;width:44px;height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;background:none;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;border-radius:50%}
.ib:hover{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--gold-d)}
.cnt{position:absolute;top:4px;right:2px;min-width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--gold);color:#fff;font-size:.7rem;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 5px}
.cnt:empty,.cnt[data-n="0"]{display:none}
.mnav{display:none}
.hero{background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:72px}
.eyebrow{color:var(--gold-d);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:14px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,3.8rem)}
.hero p{color:var(--text2);max-width:48ch;margin:20px 0 32px;font-size:1.05rem}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.frame{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--gold);padding:10px;border-radius:200px 200px 4px 4px;background:var(--bg);max-width:380px;margin-left:auto;width:100%}
.frame img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;border-radius:190px 190px 2px 2px}
.trust{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.trust .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;padding-top:22px;padding-bottom:22px}
.tr{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text2)}
.tr svg{color:var(--gold-d);width:24px;height:24px}
section.s{padding:72px 0}
.sh{margin-bottom:32px}
.sh h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.4vw,2.6rem)}
.sh p{color:var(--text2);margin:8px 0 0;max-width:56ch}
.rule{width:56px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);margin:14px 0 0;border:0}
.cats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
.cat{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 20px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:inherit;transition:border-color .2s}
.cat:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.cat h3{font-size:1.4rem}
.cat span{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text2)}
.tools{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:24px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex:1 1 100%}
.chip{min-height:40px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text2);border-radius:999px;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--champ);color:var(--text)}
.field{position:relative;flex:1 1 240px}
.field svg{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;color:var(--text2)}
input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:2px;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;width:100%}
.field input{padding-left:42px}
textarea{padding:10px 12px;min-height:84px;resize:vertical}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold);outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(198,161,91,.25)}
.sort{flex:0 0 200px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.card{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:border-color .2s}
.card:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.media{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden}
.media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.ph{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;color:var(--gold);font-size:.78rem}
.ph svg{width:40px;height:40px;stroke-width:1.2}
.badge{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px 2px 8px;font-size:.72rem;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;color:var(--text)}
.vm{width:12px;height:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--veg);display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:2px}
.vm::after{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--veg)}
.vm.nv{border-color:var(--nonveg)}.vm.nv::after{background:var(--nonveg)}
.cb{padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1}
.cb h3{font-size:1.3rem}
.cb p{margin:0;color:var(--text2);font-size:.86rem;flex:1}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:4px}
.row select{min-height:38px;width:auto;flex:0 0 96px;padding:0 8px;font-size:.88rem}
.price{font:600 1.35rem 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:var(--gold-d)}
.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:56px 16px;border:1px dashed var(--champ);color:var(--text2)}
.story{background:var(--bg2);border-block:1px solid var(--line)}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.two p{color:var(--text2);max-width:54ch}
.steps{display:grid;gap:16px}
.step{display:flex;gap:16px;padding:18px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.step b{font:600 1.8rem 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:var(--gold);line-height:1}
.step h3{font-size:1.2rem}.step p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:.9rem}
details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary::after{content:"+";color:var(--gold-d);font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1}
details[open] summary::after{content:"–"}
details p{color:var(--text2);margin:10px 0 0;max-width:70ch}
footer{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:48px 0 32px}
.fg{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
footer h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:10px}
footer a,footer span{display:block;color:var(--text2);text-decoration:none;font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:6px}
footer a:hover{color:var(--gold-d)}
.copy{margin-top:28px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text2)}
.wa{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:30;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.wa:hover{background:var(--gold-d)}
.wa svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(32,32,32,.4);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s;z-index:50}
.ov.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.dr{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(440px,100%);background:var(--bg);z-index:60;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .3s;border-left:1px solid var(--line);visibility:hidden}
.dr.on{transform:none;visibility:visible}
.dh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px 12px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.dh h2{font-size:1.6rem}
.db{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:8px 24px}
.df{padding:16px 24px calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2)}
.li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr auto;gap:12px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:center}
.li img,.li .th{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:cover;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--gold)}
.li h4{margin:0;font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem}
.li small{color:var(--text2)}
.qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:6px}
.qty button{width:34px;height:34px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--text)}
.qty button:hover{color:var(--gold-d)}
.qty span{min-width:28px;text-align:center;font-size:.9rem}
.rm{border:0;background:none;color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;width:36px;height:36px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.rm:hover{color:var(--err)}
.tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:6px}
.tot.f{font:600 1.5rem 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;color:var(--text);margin:8px 0 14px}
.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.88rem;background:var(--bg)}
.opt input{width:auto;min-height:0;margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--gold-d)}
.opt:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--champ)}
.fld{margin-bottom:12px}
.fld label{display:block;font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:4px;color:var(--text2)}
.er{color:var(--err);font-size:.8rem;min-height:1em;margin-top:2px}
.fld.bad input,.fld.bad textarea{border-color:var(--err)}
.note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text2);margin-top:10px}
.toasts{position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:calc(86px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:80;display:grid;gap:8px;width:min(92vw,360px)}
.toast{background:var(--text);color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);font-size:.9rem;animation:up .25s}
@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}}
@media(max-width:960px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.cats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.hero .wrap,.two{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}.frame{margin:0 auto}.trust .wrap{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}nav{display:none}.mnav.on{display:grid;gap:4px;padding:8px 24px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.mnav a{padding:10px 0;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text2)}.mb{display:grid!important}}
@media(max-width:520px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero .wrap{padding-top:44px;padding-bottom:44px}section.s{padding:52px 0}.sort{flex:1 1 100%}}
.mb{display:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="announce">Courier anywhere in India for a flat <b>₹100</b> · Free local delivery above <b>₹799</b> in Peddaparupudi Mandal</div>
<header>
 <div class="wrap hd">
  <a class="logo" href="#top">Mani Home Making<small>Dosapadu · Krishna District</small></a>

   <button class="ib" id="cartBtn" aria-label="Open shopping bag"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-i="bag"></svg><span class="cnt" id="cnt" data-n="0"></span></button>
   <button class="ib mb" id="mbtn" aria-label="Menu" aria-expanded="false"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-i="menu"></svg></button>
  </div>
 </div>
 <div class="mnav" id="mnav"><a href="#shop">Shop</a><a href="#story">Our story</a><a href="#order">How to order</a><a href="#faq">FAQ</a></div>
</header>
<main id="top">
<section class="hero"><div class="wrap">
 <div>
  <div class="eyebrow">Homemade in Dosapadu, Krishna District</div>
  <h1>Pickles and snacks, made at home with care</h1>
  <p>Veg and non-veg pickles, crunchy snacks and gift-ready combo packs. Order in a few taps and we confirm on WhatsApp.</p>
  <div class="ctas"><a class="btn gold" href="#shop">Shop now</a><a class="btn" href="#order">How to order</a></div>
 </div>
 <div class="frame"><img id="heroImg" alt="Jar of homemade mango pickle"></div>
</div></section>
<div class="trust"><div class="wrap">
 <div class="tr"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-i="home"></svg>Made in small home batches</div>
 <div class="tr"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-i="truck"></svg>Courier across India, flat ₹100</div>
 <div class="tr"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-i="pin"></svg>Free local delivery above ₹799</div>
 <div class="tr"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-i="wa"></svg>Order and confirm on WhatsApp</div>
</div></div>
<section class="s"><div class="wrap">
 <div class="sh"><h2>Shop by category</h2><hr class="rule"></div>
 <div class="cats" id="cats"></div>
</div></section>
<section class="s" id="shop" style="padding-top:0"><div class="wrap">
 <div class="sh"><h2>Our menu</h2><hr class="rule"><p>Pick a size, add to your bag, and send the order on WhatsApp.</p></div>
 <div class="tools">
  <div class="chips" id="chips" role="group" aria-label="Filter by category"></div>
  <div class="field"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-i="search"></svg><label class="sr" for="q">Search products</label><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search pickles, snacks, combos"></div>
  <div class="sort"><label class="sr" for="sort">Sort</label><select id="sort"><option value="f">Featured</option><option value="lo">Price: low to high</option><option value="hi">Price: high to low</option></select></div>
 </div>
 <div class="grid" id="grid" aria-live="polite"></div>
</div></section>
<section class="s story" id="story"><div class="wrap two">
 <div>
  <div class="sh"><h2>From our kitchen to yours</h2><hr class="rule"></div>
  <p>Mani Home Making is a home kitchen in Dosapadu, Peddaparupudi Mandal. We make pickles, snacks and combo packs in small batches and pack every order ourselves.</p>
  <p>Not sure what to pick? Try a combo pack, or message us and we will suggest something to your taste.</p>
  <a class="btn" href="https://wa.me/919550446661?text=Hi!%20I%20need%20help%20choosing." target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ask us on WhatsApp</a>
 </div>
 <div class="steps" id="order">
  <div class="step"><b>1</b><div><h3>Choose your items</h3><p>Add pickles, snacks or combos to your bag.</p></div></div>
  <div class="step"><b>2</b><div><h3>Send the order on WhatsApp</h3><p>Fill in your delivery details and the order opens in WhatsApp, ready to send.</p></div></div>
  <div class="step"><b>3</b><div><h3>We confirm and dispatch</h3><p>We confirm the total and payment details, then deliver locally or send by courier.</p></div></div>
 </div>
</div></section>
<section class="s" id="faq"><div class="wrap" style="max-width:820px">
 <div class="sh"><h2>Questions</h2><hr class="rule"></div>
 <details><summary>How do I place an order?</summary><p>Add items to your bag, press Checkout, enter your details and send the pre-filled message on WhatsApp. We reply to confirm your order.</p></details>
 <details><summary>Do you deliver outside Krishna District?</summary><p>Yes. We send parcels by courier anywhere in India for a flat ₹100 per order. Local delivery in Peddaparupudi Mandal is free above ₹799.</p></details>
 <details><summary>How do I pay?</summary><p>Cash on delivery for local orders. For courier orders, pay by UPI or bank transfer before dispatch. We share the details when we confirm your order. There is no online card payment on this site.</p></details>
 <details><summary>Do you ship outside India?</summary><p>Not at the moment. Message us on WhatsApp if you have a special request.</p></details>
</div></section>
</main>

<script>
var IMGS={"mango": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "lemon": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tomgon": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "gongura": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
var WA='919550446661';
var IC={search:'<circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/>',bag:'<path d="M6 2 3 6v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6l-3-4Z"/><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M16 10a4 4 0 0 1-8 0"/>',x:'<path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/>',plus:'<path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/>',minus:'<path d="M5 12h14"/>',trash:'<path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M19 6v14c0 1-1 2-2 2H7c-1 0-2-1-2-2V6"/><path d="M8 6V4c0-1 1-2 2-2h4c1 0 2 1 2 2v2"/>',wa:'<path d="M7.9 20A9 9 0 1 0 4 16.1L2 22Z"/>',truck:'<path d="M14 18V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v11a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h2"/><path d="M15 18H9"/><path d="M19 18h2a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-3.65a1 1 0 0 0-.22-.62l-3.48-4.35A1 1 0 0 0 17.52 8H14"/><circle cx="17" cy="18" r="2"/><circle cx="7" cy="18" r="2"/>',home:'<path d="m3 9 9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"/><path d="M9 22V12h6v10"/>',pin:'<path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12s-8-6-8-12a8 8 0 0 1 16 0Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>',leaf:'<path d="M11 20A7 7 0 0 1 9.8 6.1C15.5 5 17 4.48 19 2c1 2 2 4.18 2 8 0 5.5-4.78 10-10 10Z"/><path d="M2 21c0-3 1.85-5.36 5.08-6C9.5 14.52 12 13 13 12"/>',menu:'<path d="M4 12h16"/><path d="M4 6h16"/><path d="M4 18h16"/>',back:'<path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/>'};
function ic(n){return '<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24">'+IC[n]+'</svg>'}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-i]').forEach(function(e){e.innerHTML=IC[e.dataset.i]});
var $=function(s){return document.querySelector(s)};
var fmt=function(n){return '₹'+n.toLocaleString('en-IN')};
var r10=function(n){return Math.round(n/10)*10};
/* EDIT PRODUCTS HERE: base = price for the main size (pickles: 500g, snacks: 250g, combos: per pack) */
var P=[
{id:'mango',n:'Mango Pickle',c:'veg',img:'mango',b:320,k:'p',d:'Raw mango pieces cured with mustard, red chilli and oil.'},
{id:'lemon',n:'Lemon Pickle',c:'veg',img:'lemon',b:250,k:'p',d:'Whole lemons pickled with fenugreek and mustard seed.'},
{id:'tomgon',n:'Tomato + Gongura Pickle',c:'veg',img:'tomgon',b:290,k:'p',d:'Gongura leaves and ripe tomato cooked down with garlic and chilli.'},
{id:'gongura',n:'Gongura Pickle',c:'veg',img:'gongura',b:280,k:'p',d:'Gongura leaves slow-cooked with garlic and red chilli.'},
{id:'chicken',n:'Chicken Pickle',c:'nonveg',b:420,k:'p',d:'Boneless chicken cooked in red chilli and spices, sealed in oil.'},
{id:'mutton',n:'Mutton Pickle',c:'nonveg',b:550,k:'p',d:'Tender mutton cooked low and slow in a deep red masala.'},
{id:'prawn',n:'Prawn Pickle',c:'nonveg',b:480,k:'p',d:'Prawns cooked with ginger-garlic and chilli.'},
{id:'murukku',n:'Murukku',c:'snacks',b:180,k:'s',d:'Crisp rice-flour spirals with sesame and cumin.'},
{id:'mixture',n:'Mixture',c:'snacks',b:160,k:'s',d:'Crunchy mix of fried gram-flour drops, peanuts and curry leaves.'},
{id:'chekkalu',n:'Chekkalu',c:'snacks',b:160,k:'s',d:'Telugu-style rice crackers with peanuts and curry leaves.'},
{id:'chekodilu',n:'Chekodilu',c:'snacks',b:170,k:'s',d:'Ring-shaped rice crackers with a light savoury crunch.'},
{id:'boondi',n:'Boondi',c:'snacks',b:150,k:'s',d:'Tiny fried gram-flour drops seasoned with curry leaves.'},
{id:'vegc',n:'Veg Combo',c:'combo',b:650,k:'c',m:'v',d:'All 4 veg pickles, 250g each.'},
{id:'nvc',n:'Non-Veg Combo',c:'combo',b:720,k:'c',m:'n',d:'Chicken, Mutton and Prawn pickles, 250g each.'},
{id:'psc',n:'Pickle + Snacks Combo',c:'combo',b:550,k:'c',d:'Any 2 pickles (250g each) with 2 snacks (200g each).'}
];
var CATS={veg:'Veg Pickles',nonveg:'Non-Veg Pickles',snacks:'Snacks',combo:'Combo Packs'};
function sizes(p){if(p.k=='p')return[['250g',r10(p.b*.55)],['500g',p.b],['1kg',r10(p.b*1.85)]];if(p.k=='s')return[['250g',p.b],['500g',r10(p.b*1.9)]];return[['Pack',p.b]]}
var byId={};P.forEach(function(p){byId[p.id]=p});
var st={cat:'all',q:'',sort:'f'},cart=[];
try{cart=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mhm_cart')||'[]')}catch(e){cart=[]}
cart=cart.filter(function(l){return byId[l.id]&&l.qty>0&&sizes(byId[l.id]).some(function(s){return s[0]==l.size})});
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('mhm_cart',JSON.stringify(cart))}catch(e){}}
function price(l){return sizes(byId[l.id]).filter(function(s){return s[0]==l.size})[0][1]}
function sub(){return cart.reduce(function(a,l){return a+price(l)*l.qty},0)}
function toast(m){var t=document.createElement('div');t.className='toast';t.textContent=m;$('#toasts').appendChild(t);setTimeout(function(){t.remove()},2600)}
function mark(p){if(p.c=='veg'||p.c=='snacks'||p.m=='v')return'<span class="vm"></span>';if(p.c=='nonveg'||p.m=='n')return'<span class="vm nv"></span>';return''}
/* categories + chips */
$('#cats').innerHTML=Object.keys(CATS).map(function(k){var n=P.filter(function(p){return p.c==k}).length;return '<button class="cat" data-cat="'+k+'"><h3>'+CATS[k]+'</h3><span>'+n+' items</span></button>'}).join('');
function chips(){var all=[['all','All']].concat(Object.keys(CATS).map(function(k){return[k,CATS[k]]}));$('#chips').innerHTML=all.map(function(a){return '<button class="chip" data-chip="'+a[0]+'" aria-pressed="'+(st.cat==a[0])+'">'+a[1]+'</button>'}).join('')}
function grid(){
 var q=st.q.trim().toLowerCase();
 var L=P.filter(function(p){return(st.cat=='all'||p.c==st.cat)&&(!q||(p.n+' '+p.d+' '+CATS[p.c]).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1)});
 if(st.sort!='f')L.sort(function(a,b){return st.sort=='lo'?a.b-b.b:b.b-a.b});
 $('#grid').innerHTML=L.length?L.map(function(p){
  var s=sizes(p),def=s.length>1?1:0;
  return '<article class="card"><div class="media">'+(p.img?'<img loading="lazy" src="'+IMGS[p.img]+'" alt="'+p.n+'">':'<div class="ph">'+ic('leaf')+'<span>Photo coming soon</span></div>')+'<span class="badge">'+mark(p)+CATS[p.c]+'</span></div><div class="cb"><h3>'+p.n+'</h3><p>'+p.d+'</p><div class="row">'+(s.length>1?'<label class="sr" for="s-'+p.id+'">Size for '+p.n+'</label><select id="s-'+p.id+'" data-sz="'+p.id+'">'+s.map(function(x,i){return '<option value="'+x[0]+'"'+(i==def?' selected':'')+'>'+x[0]+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select>':'<span style="font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text2)">Per pack</span>')+'<span class="price" id="pr-'+p.id+'">'+fmt(s[def][1])+'</span></div><button class="btn gold" data-add="'+p.id+'">Add to bag</button></div></article>'
 }).join(''):'<div class="empty"><p style="margin:0 0 12px">No products match your search.</p><button class="btn" data-reset>Clear search</button></div>';
}
/* cart */
function badge(){var n=cart.reduce(function(a,l){return a+l.qty},0);var e=$('#cnt');e.textContent=n||'';e.dataset.n=n}
function add(id,size){var l=cart.filter(function(x){return x.id==id&&x.size==size})[0];if(l)l.qty=Math.min(l.qty+1,20);else cart.push({id:id,size:size,qty:1});save();badge();toast(byId[id].n+' ('+size+') added to bag');if($('#dr').classList.contains('on'))view()}
var delivery='courier',lastFocus=null,mode='cart';
function openCart(){lastFocus=document.activeElement;mode='cart';view();$('#ov').classList.add('on');$('#dr').classList.add('on');setTimeout(function(){$('#dx').focus()},50)}
function closeCart(){$('#ov').classList.remove('on');$('#dr').classList.remove('on');if(lastFocus)lastFocus.focus()}
function fee(s){return delivery=='courier'?100:(s>=799?0:null)}
function summary(){var s=sub(),f=fee(s);return '<div class="tot"><span>Subtotal</span><span>'+fmt(s)+'</span></div><div class="tot"><span>Delivery</span><span>'+(f===null?'Confirmed on WhatsApp':f?fmt(f):'Free')+'</span></div><div class="tot f"><span>Total</span><span>'+fmt(s+(f||0))+(f===null?'+':'')+'</span></div>'}
function delOpts(){return '<fieldset style="border:0;padding:0;margin:0 0 12px"><legend class="sr">Delivery method</legend><label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="dl" value="courier"'+(delivery=='courier'?' checked':'')+'><span><b>Courier anywhere in India</b><br>Flat ₹100 per order</span></label><label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="dl" value="local"'+(delivery=='local'?' checked':'')+'><span><b>Local delivery, Peddaparupudi Mandal</b><br>Free above ₹799, otherwise confirmed on WhatsApp</span></label></fieldset>'}
function view(){
 var v=$('#dv');
 if(!cart.length){v.innerHTML='<div class="db" style="display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:var(--text2)"><div>'+ic('bag').replace('class="i"','class="i" style="width:44px;height:44px;color:#C6A15B"')+'<p>Your bag is empty.</p><button class="btn" data-close>Continue shopping</button></div></div>';return}
 if(mode=='cart'){
  v.innerHTML='<div class="db">'+cart.map(function(l,i){var p=byId[l.id];return '<div class="li">'+(p.img?'<img src="'+IMGS[p.img]+'" alt="">':'<div class="th">'+ic('leaf')+'</div>')+'<div><h4>'+p.n+'</h4><small>'+l.size+' · '+fmt(price(l))+'</small><div class="qty"><button data-q="'+i+'" data-d="-1" aria-label="Decrease quantity">'+ic('minus')+'</button><span aria-live="polite">'+l.qty+'</span><button data-q="'+i+'" data-d="1" aria-label="Increase quantity">'+ic('plus')+'</button></div></div><div style="text-align:right"><b>'+fmt(price(l)*l.qty)+'</b><br><button class="rm" data-rm="'+i+'" aria-label="Remove '+p.n+'">'+ic('trash')+'</button></div></div>'}).join('')+'</div><div class="df">'+delOpts()+summary()+'<button class="btn gold" style="width:100%" data-go>Checkout</button><div class="note">Order is sent to us on WhatsApp. Payment is arranged after we confirm.</div></div>'
 }else{
  v.innerHTML='<form id="cf" novalidate style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;min-height:0"><div class="db"><button type="button" class="btn" style="min-height:36px;padding:0 12px;margin:8px 0 14px" data-back>'+ic('back')+'Back to bag</button>'+fld('name','Full name','text','name')+fld('phone','Mobile number (10 digits)','tel','tel')+'<div class="fld"><label for="addr">Delivery address</label><textarea id="addr" autocomplete="street-address"></textarea><div class="er" id="e-addr"></div></div>'+fld('city','Town / city','text','address-level2')+fld('pin','PIN code','text','postal-code')+'</div><div class="df">'+summary()+'<button class="btn gold" style="width:100%" type="submit">'+ic('wa')+'Send order on WhatsApp</button></div></form>'
 }
}
function fld(id,l,t,ac){return '<div class="fld"><label for="'+id+'">'+l+'</label><input id="'+id+'" type="'+t+'" autocomplete="'+ac+'"><div class="er" id="e-'+id+'"></div></div>'}
function validate(){
 var v={name:$('#name').value.trim(),phone:$('#phone').value.replace(/[\s-]/g,'').replace(/^(\+91|91|0)(?=\d{10}$)/,''),addr:$('#addr').value.trim(),city:$('#city').value.trim(),pin:$('#pin').value.trim()};
 var e={};
 if(v.name.length<2)e.name='Please enter your name.';
 if(!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(v.phone))e.phone='Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.';
 if(v.addr.length<10)e.addr='Please enter your full address (house, street, village).';
 if(v.city.length<2)e.city='Please enter your town or city.';
 if(!/^\d{6}$/.test(v.pin))e.pin='Enter a valid 6-digit PIN code.';
 ['name','phone','addr','city','pin'].forEach(function(k){$('#e-'+k).textContent=e[k]||'';$('#'+k).closest('.fld').classList.toggle('bad',!!e[k]);$('#'+k).setAttribute('aria-invalid',!!e[k])});
 var first=Object.keys(e)[0];if(first){$('#'+first).focus();return null}return v
}
function send(v){
 var s=sub(),f=fee(s),lines=cart.map(function(l,i){return (i+1)+'. '+byId[l.id].n+' ('+l.size+') x '+l.qty+' = '+fmt(price(l)*l.qty)});
 var msg='Hi Mani Home Making! I would like to order:\n\n'+lines.join('\n')+'\n\nSubtotal: '+fmt(s)+'\nDelivery: '+(delivery=='courier'?'Courier (Rs 100)':'Local delivery'+(f===0?' (free)':' (to be confirmed)'))+'\nTotal: '+fmt(s+(f||0))+(f===null?' + delivery':'')+'\n\nName: '+v.name+'\nMobile: '+v.phone+'\nAddress: '+v.addr+', '+v.city+' - '+v.pin;
 window.open('https://wa.me/'+WA+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(msg),'_blank','noopener');
 cart=[];save();badge();closeCart();toast('Opening WhatsApp. Please press send to place your order.');
}
/* events */
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
 var t=e.target,b;
 if(b=t.closest('[data-add]')){var id=b.dataset.add,sel=$('#s-'+id);add(id,sel?sel.value:'Pack');return}
 if(b=t.closest('[data-cat]')){st.cat=b.dataset.cat;chips();grid();$('#shop').scrollIntoView();return}
 if(b=t.closest('[data-chip]')){st.cat=b.dataset.chip;chips();grid();return}
 if(t.closest('[data-reset]')){st.q='';$('#q').value='';st.cat='all';chips();grid();return}
 if(t.closest('#cartBtn')){openCart();return}
 if(t.closest('#dx')||t.closest('#ov')||t.closest('[data-close]')){closeCart();return}
 if(b=t.closest('[data-q]')){var l=cart[+b.dataset.q];l.qty+=+b.dataset.d;if(l.qty<1)cart.splice(+b.dataset.q,1);if(l&&l.qty>20)l.qty=20;save();badge();view();return}
 if(b=t.closest('[data-rm]')){var n=byId[cart[+b.dataset.rm].id].n;cart.splice(+b.dataset.rm,1);save();badge();view();toast(n+' removed');return}
 if(t.closest('[data-go]')){mode='form';view();return}
 if(t.closest('[data-back]')){mode='cart';view();return}
 if(t.closest('#srch')){$('#shop').scrollIntoView();setTimeout(function(){$('#q').focus()},350);return}
 if(t.closest('#mbtn')){var m=$('#mnav'),o=m.classList.toggle('on');$('#mbtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);return}
 if(t.closest('#mnav a'))$('#mnav').classList.remove('on');
});
document.addEventListener('change',function(e){
 var t=e.target;
 if(t.dataset.sz){var p=byId[t.dataset.sz];$('#pr-'+p.id).textContent=fmt(sizes(p).filter(function(s){return s[0]==t.value})[0][1])}
 if(t.name=='dl'){delivery=t.value;view()}
 if(t.id=='sort'){st.sort=t.value;grid()}
});
$('#q').addEventListener('input',function(e){st.q=e.target.value;grid()});
document.addEventListener('submit',function(e){if(e.target.id=='cf'){e.preventDefault();var v=validate();if(v)send(v)}});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
 var d=$('#dr');
 if(e.key=='Escape'&&d.classList.contains('on'))closeCart();
 if(e.key=='Tab'&&d.classList.contains('on')){var f=d.querySelectorAll('button,input,textarea,select,a[href]');if(!f.length)return;var a=f[0],z=f[f.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement==a){e.preventDefault();z.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement==z){e.preventDefault();a.focus()}}
});
$('#heroImg').src=IMGS.mango;
chips();grid();badge();
</script>
</body>
</html>
